* {{ill|Sashino Shrine (Ishioka Kakio)|ja|佐志能神社 (石岡市柿岡)}} (さしのじんじゃ) - Located in [[:en:Ishioka|Ishioka]], Kakio, Ibaraki Prefecture. Also listed in the Engishiki as a minor shrine. Classified as a village shrine (村社).
* {{ill|Sashino Shrine|ja|佐志能神社 (石岡市染谷)|qid=Q17225838}} (さしのじんじゃ) - Located in Someya and Murakami, Ishioka, Ibaraki Prefecture. Listed in the Engishiki as a minor shrine. Classified as a district shrine (郷社).
